title: Weeknote #2028
summary: All GTA, all the time. Maybe some other links.
content:
Googling this week:

  • dr who at ibm
  • mango ink
  • billericay to london

GTA continues to be bloody excellent. Here's an accurate representation of me thinking playing GTA when I'm doing literally anything else:

The Birds of GTA 6: A Field Guide to Vice City & Leonida’s Wildlife. I love this.

Merlin Mann, famed internet man, is releasing various formats of his wisdom project including EPUBs and PDFs.

Zoe told me about the "grail diary" concept wherein you have a single notebook, or diary, for a single goal. This article explains it better than I can summarise it and this video is where Zoe heard about it.

Mr Hackett has another app out this week, this time Cruiser which allows you to search your history and bookmarks from multiple browsers.

James put together a self-hosted alternative to Last.fm. I like the idea but I really have no energy to try and proxy Last.fm requests to somewhere else. At least they're still allowing scrobbling for free users now.

Rach nailed a feeling I think a lot of us are having with this post — The nature of my job has completely changed.

Two excellent Lego Marvel sets coming soon — Jeff the Land Shark which I am definitely buying and The Marvel Skyline which I won't be buying but looks very cool.

Another open source mono font, this time from Frere-Jones Type.

Design a Ladder Icon From Scratch with Noah Jacobus. Noah does excellent work at Font Awesome so it's fun to see how the process works.

Silo is a new media server that looks interesting and it has apps for iOS, tvOS, and macOS right out of the gate.
